meta.edge_semantics: A in prereqs of B means B cannot be honestly understood without A. Edges are transitively reduced: if A->B->C, the edge A->C is omitted.
meta.fluency_floor_note: Every node in track C, D or A implicitly assumes the reader can read C at the level of these five nodes. This is assumed, not drawn, to keep the graph sparse.

nodes.title: Number bases: binary, decimal, hexadecimal
nodes.scope: Positional notation in an arbitrary base; binary and hexadecimal; conversion both directions; why one byte is exactly two hex digits; powers of two and the 2^10 = 10^3 approximation. Unsigned only.

nodes.title: Propositional logic
nodes.scope: Propositions; and, or, not, implication, biconditional; truth tables; tautology and contradiction; logical equivalence; De Morgan; contrapositive versus converse; why implication has the truth table it has.

nodes.title: Sets and functions
nodes.scope: Set notation, membership, subset, union, intersection, difference, Cartesian product; N, Z, R; finite cardinality; functions with domain and codomain; injective, surjective, bijective; composition.

nodes.title: Predicates and quantifiers
nodes.scope: Predicates as parameterised propositions; universal and existential quantifiers; bound variables; nested quantifiers and why their order changes meaning; negation of quantified statements.

nodes.title: Growth of functions: polynomial, exponential, logarithmic
nodes.scope: Comparing f(n) and g(n) as n grows; linear, quadratic, polynomial, exponential; the logarithm as the inverse of exponentiation; log_2 n as the number of halvings; log identities; why the base changes only a constant factor.

nodes.title: Proof by induction
nodes.scope: Weak induction: base case, inductive step, inductive hypothesis. Worked proofs of summation identities, divisibility, and inequalities. Strong induction. Standard failure modes: absent base case, hypothesis applied at the wrong index.

nodes.title: Summations and closed forms
nodes.scope: Sigma notation and index manipulation; arithmetic series n(n+1)/2; geometric series and its closed form; sums arising from nested loops; each closed form proved, not asserted.

nodes.title: Asymptotic notation: O, Omega, Theta
nodes.scope: Formal definitions of O, Omega, Theta with the explicit quantifier structure; proving membership from the definition; why constants and lower-order terms vanish; O as an upper bound rather than a tight one; the worst-case/best-case confusion addressed directly.

nodes.title: Graphs and trees as mathematical objects
nodes.scope: G = (V, E); directed, undirected, weighted; adjacency and degree; walks, paths, cycles; connectivity and components; acyclicity; trees and |E| = |V| - 1; rooted trees, parent, child, leaf, depth, height; binary trees and node counts per level.

nodes.title: Recurrence relations
nodes.scope: T(n) expressed in terms of smaller arguments; solving by unrolling; guess and verify by induction; recursion trees; the shapes T(n) = T(n-1) + f(n) and T(n) = a T(n/b) + f(n); the master theorem stated and applied, not proved.

nodes.title: Counting and expected value
nodes.scope: Sum and product rules; permutations and combinations; uniform probability on a finite sample space; expectation and linearity of expectation. Included only to make average-case claims honest.

nodes.title: The comparison-sort lower bound
nodes.scope: Decision trees for comparison sorts; n! leaves; height at least log_2(n!); Stirling bound giving Omega(n log n).

nodes.title: The machine model
nodes.scope: Bits, bytes, addresses, memory as an addressable array; hexadecimal byte notation; the untyped nature of memory; registers; fetch-decode-execute; the program counter; stored-program; virtual addresses and pipelining flagged as simplifications.

nodes.title: Building and running a C program
nodes.scope: Installing a compiler on Linux, macOS and Windows; a minimal main; printf; the compile-then-run cycle with the toolchain as a black box; reading a first compiler error; source file versus executable file versus running process; exit status.

nodes.title: Variables, types, and memory addresses
nodes.scope: Declaration and definition; a type as size plus interpretation; sizeof; the address-of operator; scope and lifetime of automatic variables; assignment as a write to an address; uninitialised variables.

nodes.title: Integer representation, fixed width, and overflow
nodes.scope: Fixed-width integer types; unsigned wraparound; two's complement; signed overflow as undefined behaviour; char as a small integer and ASCII; implicit conversion and truncation; stdint.h.

nodes.title: Expressions, operators, and conditionals
nodes.scope: Arithmetic, relational and logical operators; precedence; integer division and modulo; truth as zero versus non-zero; short-circuit evaluation; if, else, else-if, switch; the assignment-in-condition error.

nodes.title: Loops and iteration
nodes.scope: while, for, do-while; break and continue; off-by-one errors; nested loops; termination and non-termination.

nodes.title: Functions, parameters, and pass-by-value
nodes.scope: Declaration versus definition; parameters and arguments; return values; void; pass-by-value demonstrated by showing the caller's variable unchanged; prototypes; local scope. Recursion deliberately excluded.

nodes.title: The stack and function calls
nodes.scope: Stack frames and their contents; push on call, pop on return; the return address; why locals cease to exist; call depth and stack overflow; why returning a pointer to a local is wrong.

nodes.title: Recursion
nodes.scope: Base case and recursive case; trusting the recursive call as an inductive hypothesis; frame-by-frame tracing; factorial, Fibonacci, binary recursion; the exponential cost of naive Fibonacci argued qualitatively; missing base case as stack overflow.

nodes.title: Pointers
nodes.scope: A pointer as a typed address; address-of and dereference; NULL; pointer to pointer; out-parameters; swap; why the pointed-to type matters; the misconception that a pointer contains the value.

nodes.title: Arrays and contiguous memory
nodes.scope: Declaration; zero-based indexing; contiguity; the address arithmetic the compiler performs; iteration; sizeof on an array; fixed compile-time size; absence of bounds checking and what actually happens on overrun; two-dimensional arrays in row-major order.

nodes.title: Pointer arithmetic and array decay
nodes.scope: p + 1 scaled by the element size; pointer difference; array-to-pointer decay; why sizeof fails on a parameter; passing an array with an explicit length; one-past-the-end; the equivalence of a[i] and *(a + i).

nodes.title: Structs and memory layout
nodes.scope: Aggregate types; member access via dot and arrow; structs copied on assignment and on call; layout, padding and alignment; sizeof of a struct; nesting; typedef; arrays of structs.

nodes.title: Strings as char arrays
nodes.scope: NUL termination; char arrays versus string literals; why literals are read-only; strlen as a linear scan; strcpy, strcmp, strcat and their buffer requirements; the terminator off-by-one; each function reimplemented by hand.

nodes.title: The heap: malloc, free, and object lifetime
nodes.scope: Automatic versus allocated lifetime; malloc, calloc, realloc, free; checking for NULL; computing the size correctly; ownership; returning allocated memory from a function; why the stack cannot do this.

nodes.title: Memory errors: leaks, dangling pointers, use-after-free
nodes.scope: Leaks, double free, use-after-free, dangling pointers, buffer overruns, reading uninitialised memory; why the symptom surfaces far from the cause; valgrind and -fsanitize=address.

nodes.title: Multi-file programs, headers, and linking
nodes.scope: Translation units; declaration versus definition revisited; header files and include guards; extern; static for internal linkage; distinguishing compiler errors from linker errors; a minimal Makefile.

nodes.title: Function pointers
nodes.scope: Syntax; taking a function's address; calling through a pointer; passing behaviour as an argument; the qsort comparator; dispatch tables.

nodes.title: Growable arrays: realloc and amortised doubling
nodes.scope: realloc semantics and pointer invalidation; capacity versus length; geometric growth; why growing by a constant is quadratic and doubling is amortised constant, argued from the geometric series.

nodes.title: Debugging: printf, gdb, sanitisers
nodes.scope: Reading a compiler error properly; printf instrumentation; gdb break, run, step, print, backtrace; reading a stack trace; sanitisers; forming a hypothesis and shrinking the failing input.

nodes.title: Linked lists
nodes.scope: Self-referential node struct; head pointer; traversal; insertion at head, tail and interior; deletion; freeing the whole list; the dummy-head technique; doubly linked lists; when a list beats an array and when it does not.

nodes.title: Stacks and queues
nodes.scope: Abstract data type versus implementation; push and pop, enqueue and dequeue; array-backed circular buffer and list-backed versions; the constant-time claims; underflow and overflow.

nodes.title: Binary trees and traversals
nodes.scope: Node struct with two children; the recursive structure; preorder, inorder, postorder; height and node counts; recursive size, height and destruction; iterative traversal with an explicit stack; why traversal is naturally recursive.

nodes.title: Binary search trees
nodes.scope: The ordering invariant; search, insert, and the three deletion cases; inorder traversal producing sorted order; height as the cost determinant; degeneration to a list on sorted input; balancing named but not implemented.

nodes.title: Hash tables
nodes.scope: Mapping keys to indices; hash functions for integers and strings; collisions; separate chaining; load factor and rehashing; open addressing and clustering; average versus worst case; how a poor hash destroys the guarantee.

nodes.title: Binary heaps and priority queues
nodes.scope: The heap property; a complete binary tree stored in an array; parent and child index arithmetic; sift up and sift down; insert and extract-min; linear-time build-heap; heapsort.

nodes.title: Representing graphs: adjacency matrix and adjacency list
nodes.scope: Adjacency matrix versus adjacency list; space and time tradeoffs; directed, undirected and weighted variants; construction from an edge list; iterating over neighbours.

nodes.title: Counting operations: analysing iterative algorithms
nodes.scope: Counting primitive operations; loop counts as summations; nested loops; best, worst and average case; converting a count into Theta; defining input size; the error of assuming nested loops are always quadratic.

nodes.title: Loop invariants and correctness
nodes.scope: What an invariant is; initialisation, maintenance, termination; proving a loop computes what it claims; deriving the postcondition from the invariant and the negated guard; invariants for sum, maximum, and insertion sort's inner loop.

nodes.title: Linear search and binary search
nodes.scope: Linear search and its linear cost; binary search on a sorted array; the invariant; correct midpoint computation and the overflow bug; termination; the halving recurrence giving logarithmic cost; boundary off-by-one errors.

nodes.title: Elementary sorts: selection, insertion, bubble
nodes.scope: Selection, insertion and bubble sort; invariants for each; comparison and swap counts; best, worst and average case; stability; in-place operation; why insertion sort wins on nearly-sorted input.

nodes.title: Analysing recursive algorithms
nodes.scope: Deriving the recurrence from the code; recursion trees; solving by unrolling and verifying by induction; applying the master theorem; accounting for space as well as time.

nodes.title: Mergesort
nodes.scope: Merging two sorted runs; the scratch buffer and its allocation; recursive splitting; T(n) = 2T(n/2) + Theta(n); stability; linear extra space; the bottom-up variant.

nodes.title: Quicksort
nodes.scope: Lomuto and Hoare partitioning; recursion on the parts; best, worst and average case; pivot choice; quadratic behaviour on sorted input with a naive pivot; in-place operation; recursion depth.

nodes.title: Breadth-first search
nodes.scope: Layer-by-layer exploration; the queue; visited marking; shortest paths in unweighted graphs; parent array and path reconstruction; Theta(V + E); why vertices are marked on enqueue rather than dequeue.

nodes.title: Depth-first search
nodes.scope: Recursive and explicit-stack formulations; discovery and finish; visited marking; connected components; cycle detection; Theta(V + E); recursion depth on large graphs; contrast with BFS.

nodes.title: Generic sorting with comparators
nodes.scope: Comparator function signature; void* elements; byte-level swapping; using qsort; the type safety that is given up.
